title: Compatible internal condensed bar and scalar comparison data
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], with its internal modules [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], and use the ordinary derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Use the landed internal profinite-group action category, equivariant maps, forgetful functor and normalized invariants of [def-sfb-condensed-action-module], and the section-module equivalence of [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. The free internal module $A[P]$ on a profinite parameter $P$ is the composite of the free abelian sheaf functor (sheafified free abelian group, left adjoint of forgetting to condensed sets) and the free module functor $A\otimes-$ of [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], applied to the representable sheaf of $P$. Define the following specification of compatible bar data (not a choice from a mere existence theorem). Internal functions from $P$ are internal module Hom from $A[P]$, identified on sections at $S$ with natural families assigning to every $T\to S$ and continuous $T\to P$ a section of $M(T)$; the evaluation respects addition, scalar multiplication, restriction and postcomposition. The cosimplicial diagram in degree $p$ is this internal function module on $G^p$, with first face using the action, interior faces multiplying adjacent entries, last face dropping the last entry, and degeneracies inserting the identity. Define its alternating cochains. The invariant augmentation in bar degree zero is the given inclusion, interpreted as constant internal functions. Applying the whole diagram to one nonnegative equivariant injective resolution [def-sp-injective-resolutions] gives a first-quadrant double complex, whose finite-diagonal total [def-sp-double-complex-total] has differential $d_{bar}+(-1)^p d_{resolution}$. Specify the total augmentation on each invariant resolution term by the bar-zero coprojection. An abelian-structure datum retains exactly the landed additive structure. A computation datum asserts that forgetting is exact and preserves injectives, that each derived-unit comparison on the underlying injective resolution is invertible, and that the total augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism. Its displayed isomorphism from the ordinary total right derived invariants to the localized total is normalized by that augmentation and commutes with every chain lift of every equivariant module map. A scalar datum for $A\to A'$ is restriction of the action with underlying ordinary internal scalar restriction [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars], together with invariant and bar isomorphisms fixed by their inclusions and evaluations. Its total isomorphism is fixed on every double-complex summand. Define the invariant and total comparison chain maps using these isomorphisms and any augmentation-preserving lift $\operatorname{Res}J\to I$ between the nonnegative resolutions. A scalar computation specifies existence of such lifts, the quasi-isomorphisms on every column, invariants and totals for every such lift, and commutation of the localized augmentation square after inversion. Finally, the proposition Assertion(G) says that these structures and models exist for every commutative condensed ring, together with these normalized scalar data for every ring morphism. Thus the proposition adds no abelianness, injectivity, flatness or arbitrary-map assumptions to its consuming theorem.
